text: or do i just rotate it actually in the studio ?
resolution: User asked whether to fix the upside-down texture-slot image in code or just rotate it in the Studio. Answered: rotating works per-model but if every slot image arrives upside-down it's a systematic V-orientation convention worth a one-line code flip; user chose to rotate in Studio and it fixed their case. No code change. Same underlying item as req_1678.
